info.title: Supplier Portal MNR System Integration
info.description:
# API Specification File
       This is the API specification for vendors to integrate with the OOCL and COSCO MNR systems.
       Please feel free to reach out to us if you have any queries or need support. You can contact Supplier Portal Digital Home Support by email.
       OOCL: supplierdigital.supp@oocl.com
       COSCO: supplierdigital.supp@coscon.com
  ## Error codes 
       In this API will response below error codes for different scenarios.
    ### For 400 error status for search standard route
       | Error code| Message | 
       | ----------- | ----------- | 
       | 400 | Bad Request |
       | 401 | Unauthorized |
       | 403 | Forbidden |
       | 404 | Not Found |
       | 500 | Unexpected Exception |
